title: Mention versus demonstrated evidence
purpose: Two skills (GraphQL, MongoDB) appear only in the skills line, two (React, TypeScript) are used in described work, one (Next.js) has related use only, and one (Cypress) is absent. Tests that a bare mention is not treated as demonstrated proficiency and that ATS bullets do not upgrade a mention into an achievement.
